submission.summary: pt-2001 edoxaban stopped (CrCl about 161, above 95) and switched to apixaban 5 mg BID. pt-2002 rivaroxaban reduced to 15 mg daily (CrCl about 29). pt-2003 dabigatran reduced to 75 mg BID (CrCl about 39 with dronedarone). pt-2004 apixaban raised to 5 mg BID (age 81 only). pt-2005 apixaban 2.5 mg BID and pt-2006 rivaroxaban 20 mg daily are correct.
